findings.title: Author Genie space artifacts in round-trip-stable form — `join_specs[*]` sorted by `id`, `text_instructions[]` as one consolidated block, `version: 2` — so POST-then-GET produces zero diff and future edits don't churn.

findings.title: Add `synonyms=[...]` to every column with a description in a Genie space — without synonyms, Genie's NL→SQL grounding drops business terms (e.g. "customer" never resolves to `cust_id`).
findings.hint: Python file uses Genie SDK markers (REST call, create_space(), update_space(), GenieSpace, serialized_space, genie_room) but never references `synonyms`. Add synonyms per relevant column so Genie can match business vocabulary to the schema. (Broadened from the narrow deploy-notebook filename convention to cover apps/SDK deploys per the 2026-05-19 Valeo critique.)

findings.title: Enable Genie format assistance — without it, Genie returns raw SQL output instead of formatted answers, and downstream agents (chat panes, briefings) lose the structured shape they need.
findings.hint: Python file uses Genie SDK markers but never references `format_assistance` (kwarg-style or dict-key) — set `format_assistance=True` on the space config (and pair with `entity_matching=True` per BP-550).

findings.title: Set a Genie space thumbnail (or emoji / cover_image) — bare spaces show as identical tiles in the Genie picker, which kills the per-persona visual cue customers expect at workshop time.
findings.hint: Python file uses Genie SDK markers but never references thumbnail / emoji / cover_image / icon. Per `rules/api_capabilities.yaml`, the upload endpoints PUT/POST `/api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}/{thumbnail,image,icon,cover-image}` are unsupported (return 404), so set the thumbnail via the Genie UI after deploy and verify with `GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}` that the field is non-empty.

findings.title: Introspect every Genie-referenced table live (DESCRIBE / COUNT / COLLECT_SET on enum columns) before drafting SQL — without it, sample_questions and CSEs are written against assumed cardinality and enum values, which is the #1 source of CRITICAL Genie review findings (non-unique join keys, unknown enum values, zero-row edge cases).
findings.hint: Python file uses Genie SDK markers but contains no DESCRIBE / COUNT(*) / COLLECT_SET probe. Live-introspect every referenced table before drafting sample_questions or CSEs so join cardinality, enum values, and row-count edge cases are evidence-based, not assumed. (Narrowed pattern_any to Genie SDK markers — was `tables=|table_name=|CREATE TABLE`, which false-positived on every dbt model / Spark table-creation script when glob broadened.)

findings.title: Populate `instructions.example_question_sqls[]` on every Genie space — these are the curated example queries Genie shows alongside curated_questions; without them, the model has nothing to ground new questions against.

findings.title: Maintain a per-persona × per-tab parity matrix — UI route changes should not silently diverge from one persona to another.
Reference brand assets (logos, palette colors) through a manifest with sha256 — inline SVGs drift from official brand.
Persist customer brief (attendees, personas, success outcomes, demo flows, excluded scopes) as a versioned requirements.yaml — workshop intent should not live only in chat.
When databricks.yml resources or app.yml change, require a parallel diff in docs/{DEPLOY,RUNBOOK,CHANGELOG_*}.md — runbooks should not lag implementation.
Multi-agent repos must declare branch ownership (.vibe-doctor/branch_ownership.yaml) — pre-push hook rejects overlapping path ownership across active PRs.
Don't track generated files (routeTree.gen.ts, *.gen.{js,py}) — re-generation churn poisons PR diffs and merges.

findings.title: Each persona Genie space ships a golden_questions.yaml — every question carries assertions (required columns, metric thresholds, min row count, regex snippets) executed at smoke time.
Project ships a vibe-doctor.yaml declaring named gates {name, severity, command, pass_when} — diagnostics need codified pass/fail.
Emit a SESSION_STATE.md checkpoint at 80% context budget — open issues, fixed invariants, branches, deploy URL, last smoke result — so a context reset doesn't lose state.

Verify a Genie space_id with GET before issuing any update/POST — blind updates against a stale or non-existent space_id silently no-op or create a sibling space, neither of which surfaces an error to the caller.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}
online.expect_text: every space_id referenced in the project resolves (200)

findings.title: Introspect every Genie-referenced table live (DESCRIBE / COUNT / COLLECT_SET on enum columns) before drafting SQL — without it, sample_questions and CSEs are written against assumed cardinality and enum values, which is the #1 source of CRITICAL Genie review findings (non-unique join keys, unknown enum values, zero-row edge cases).

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}
online.expect_text: every column with an enum-shape description (e.g. "one of: a, b, c") corresponds to a real `ARRAY_JOIN(COLLECT_SET(col))` over the underlying table

findings.title: Author Genie space artifacts in round-trip-stable form — `join_specs[*]` sorted by `id`, `text_instructions[]` as one consolidated block, `version: 2` — so POST-then-GET produces zero diff and future edits don't churn.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}
online.expect_text: version == 2; join_specs[*] sorted ascending by id; text_instructions length <= 1

findings.title: Ship at least one `ask_genie` smoke-test artifact per Genie space — a real natural-language question whose row count is cross-checked against direct SQL via the warehouse. Round-trip GET alone misses binding/entity-match/join failures; only a real NL roundtrip catches them.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}/conversations?limit=1
online.expect_text: at least one conversation exists post-deploy

findings.title: Relabel the UI surface for known data artefacts — when a column or family is known to be a math/data artefact (e.g. clean family flagged CRITICAL due to drift-score artefact), reword sample_questions and instructions to neutral terms (`monitored families` not `adversarial families`; `configured threshold and alert status` not `breached threshold`) rather than rewiring the schema.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}
online.expect_text: sample_questions and instructions avoid loaded labels ("adversarial", "breached", "violation") on columns/families documented as known data artefacts

findings.title: Populate `instructions.example_question_sqls[]` on every Genie space — these are the curated example queries Genie shows alongside curated_questions; without them, the model has nothing to ground new questions against.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}
online.expect_text: space.instructions.example_question_sqls is a non-empty array; every item has non-empty `sql` and `usage_guidance`

findings.title: Declare `instructions.join_specs[]` when a Genie space references ≥2 tables — without declared joins, Genie writes ad-hoc JOIN SQL that ignores cardinality and produces row-explosion bugs (the BP-554 live-introspection lesson is moot if joins aren't pre-declared).

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}
online.expect_text: when space.data_sources.tables has ≥2 entries, space.instructions.join_specs is non-empty

findings.title: Embed relationship-type cardinality in every `join_specs[*].sql` (e.g. `--rt=FROM_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ONE_TO_ONE--`) — Genie reads this comment to plan JOIN cardinality; without it, the planner defaults to MANY_TO_MANY and emits row-explosion JOINs.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}

findings.title: Populate `instructions.sql_snippets` with reusable filters, expressions, and measures — these are the named SQL fragments Genie composes user-questions from; without them, every answer rebuilds aggregations from scratch and answer style drifts across questions.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}
online.expect_text: space.instructions.sql_snippets has non-empty filters + (expressions OR measures)

findings.title: Every `sql_snippets[*]` (filter / expression / measure) ships at least one `synonyms[]` entry — without synonyms, Genie can't map user phrasing (`brake rate`, `BRAKE share`) to the named snippet, defeating the entire point of declaring the snippet.

online.endpoint: GET /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{id}

findings.title: Make Unity Catalog the default governance plane for all data and AI assets.
Use service principals for all jobs and automation.
Set max scaling (max clusters) to control cost ceilings.
Use Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (DLT) for all production ETL/ELT.
Set pipeline target to a Unity Catalog schema, not the legacy Hive metastore.
Use Enhanced Autoscaling in DLT to balance cost and throughput.
Monitor pipeline freshness: alert if a pipeline hasn't completed within its SLA.
Separate dev, staging, and prod environments at the workspace or catalog level.
Bind Databricks Apps to a `budget_policy_id` — Apps surface in system.billing.usage but the DAB schema rejects `tags` on `resources.apps.*`. The budget policy is the FinOps lever.
Extract shared logic into Python packages or wheel files, not copy-pasted cells; declare hatchling wheel layout explicitly when [project] name changes.
findings.hint: pyproject.toml declares hatchling backend but no [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] block — hatchling will fall back to default discovery. After a project rename this ships an empty wheel to Apps. See P11 in docs/demos/socomec-personas-postmortem.md.
